questions.question: What is a nested if statement?

options.value: Any if with a long condition

questions.explanation: Nesting makes one decision depend on entry into an outer branch.

questions.question: How many bodies run in an if / else if / else chain?

options.value: None if any condition is true

questions.explanation: The first true condition selects its branch and skips the rest of the chain.

questions.question: Why can ordering matter in an else-if chain?

options.value: Only the last test is evaluated
An earlier broad condition can hide a later specific one

questions.explanation: Once a branch is selected, later conditions are not tested.

questions.question: Without braces, which if does an else pair with?

options.value: Always the first if in the method

questions.explanation: The language pairing rule is independent of indentation.

questions.question: What does adding explicit braces improve in nested selection?

options.value: It forces both branches to execute

questions.explanation: Clear grouping prevents misleading indentation and dangling-else mistakes.

questions.question: In if (a) { if (b) action(); }, when does action run?

options.value: When both a and b are true

questions.explanation: The inner statement is reached only through a true outer condition.

questions.question: When is the final else in a chain selected?

options.value: When all preceding tests were false
When the first test was true

questions.explanation: The final else is the fallback path.
